## Change

F1. Resolve canonical root/candidate paths before local runtime metadata/hash reads. Reject directory symlinks escaping declared snapshot root; existing lexical path checks retained.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN uses synthetic outside artifact and in-root escaping symlink. Parent reviewed canonical containment/path use and fixture; reran 44 containment/manifest/runtime-setup tests. Worker including boundaries: 96; typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Limits

L1. Local Node validator only. Does not make mutable filesystem traversal atomic against hostile concurrent changes. Browser fetch/digest behavior unchanged; no live assets acquired. Full CI has sampled acquisition failures; no full-CI-green claim.
title: fix(assets): contain runtime verification within snapshot root
